name: agent-bridge
description: Delegate tasks and share context between local Codex and Claude Code sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks and share context across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Ask the backend session to implement a feature or send context of current changes to the frontend session. Agent Bridge discovers the matching local Codex or Claude Code session, sends the request, and delivers replies automatically.
interface.defaultPrompt: Send context of current changes to the frontend session.
